answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Hardware-signed execution quotes per key; a farm of clones shares one TPM and one quote fails the count. A garden of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the basalt of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and ledge-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Cost compounds for fakes exactly as trust compounds for honest keys.
